prayerExcerpt.en-US: Devotion to the blessed Mother of God is the sure protection of faith in her Divine Son.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: A devoção à bendita Mãe de Deus é a segura proteção da fé em seu Filho Divino.

meta.face: A Greek of Pontus of about sixty with a warm, light olive complexion and a NARROW face with SUNKEN TEMPLES — a HIGH, BALD crown with a single short CURL of white hair left over the middle of the forehead and thick, short white curls over the ears; a DEEP vertical FURROW between the brows; a LONG, STRAIGHT, NARROW nose running down from it; small, CLOSE-SET, deep-brown eyes under brows that slant gently UP toward the centre in a look of concentration; flat cheeks; a small, tight mouth; a SHORT, CURLY, rounded white beard; the gaze grave and searching, toward us. Not the long-bearded athanasius, the rectangular, square-jawed lambert, the trapezoid hilary, the domed honoratus or the long, symmetrical remigius.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The face follows the Painter's Manual ('an old man with curly hair and a short beard') and the Greek icon on English Wikipedia (a narrow face, balding, with a curl over the brow and a short white beard); the tree on the riverbank is the staff that held back the Lycus, from Santi e Beati's notice.
